# BrandRoot Salon & Spa Ltd.

> Nashik's most luxurious salon & spa destination, located opposite City Centre Mall. 4.8★ Google rating from 350+ reviews. Family-run premium beauty & wellness brand offering hair care, skin care, spa & wellness, bridal makeup, nail studio and men's grooming services.

## Services
- Hair Care: haircuts & styling, wash & blow dry, color & highlights (balayage, ombre), keratin & hair spa treatments, extensions
- Skin Care: organic & O3+ premium facials, advanced skin treatments (anti-aging, pigmentation), threading & waxing, clean-up & tan removal
- Spa & Wellness: classical relaxing spa, Swedish massage, deep tissue massage, aromatherapy, head & shoulder massage, steam & shower
- Bridal & Makeup: HD/airbrush bridal makeup, party & event makeup, makeovers, mehendi & pre-bridal packages
- Nail Studio: manicure, pedicure, nail art, acrylic & gel extensions
- Men's Grooming: haircut & styling, beard grooming, men's facial, men's spa

## Membership Packages (12-month validity)
- Silver Plan — ₹32,000 (value ₹45,600): 12× relaxing massage (60 min), 12× haircut + wash
- Gold Plan — ₹55,000 (value ₹75,600, most popular): 12× relaxing massage, 12× haircut + wash, 12× head massage, 6× O3+ premium facial
- Platinum Plan — ₹75,000 (value ₹1,10,000): 9× relaxing massage, 6× manicure + pedicure, 6× haircut + wash, 6× O3+ premium facial, 6× full body waxing
